parent: each seed's D3 optimizer-boundary checkpoint at 1300
budget_randomness: Three draws every frame: pair coin, uniform adjacent edge, orientation. Main is the chosen oriented edge endpoint for all arms, including single-budget frames. Thus main histories and latent auxiliary proposals match even for U3. Endpoint main probabilities 1/6, interior 1/3.

training_views.reduction: equal mean of global and native LPIPS, same sampled coordinates for both budgets
training_views.crop_coordinates: x,y,width,height; per-frame independent CPU Generator; saved in checkpoint and frame log
training_views.U0: original full-resolution LPIPS objective; draws and records the same audit crop

weights: Alex lambda 0.1; VGG lambda calibrated once using median RGB gradient-norm ratio on frozen parent reconstructions of Train frames. Raw losses, gradient norms and model hashes recorded. Weights are not intrinsically interchangeable.
short_sources: Use all available contiguous frames, never repeat or invent frames; explicitly report sources shorter than 64. car-roundabout supplies 64.

selection_A.rank: Among arms improving mean full-resolution LPIPS in both seeds, lowest two-seed mean across four independent budget loops; if none qualifies, retain the lowest mean as a negative fine-tuning candidate. Never training LPIPS.
selection_A.preferred_training_gate: mean LPIPS lower than matched U0 in both seeds; all budgets PSNR drop <=0.05 dB, LPIPS/DISTS increase <=0.005
selection_A.if_not_pass: retain best unified objective as an explicitly negative fine-tune candidate, then diagnose N0/N1/N2 from scratch

selection_B.300_to_1000: all six runs have finite updates, <=0.95 maximum code fraction at final step, positive finite per-level variance and VQ loss; no arm >0.5 dB below N0 or LPIPS >0.03 above N0 at any budget
selection_B.1000_to_3000_5000: both seeds pass non-regression versus N0 at every budget (PSNR -0.05 dB, LPIPS/DISTS +0.005) with strict mean LPIPS improvement; positive K2048 over K1024 same-state PSNR and LPIPS gains; Fine permutation and cross-video replacement raise MSE
selection_B.failure: archive negative result, stop extra updates and architecture growth

evaluation_protocol: Full 1080p float32 LPIPS-Alex v0.1 and DISTS; independent sender and receiver, GOP32, discrete 13-bit packets; each budget owns its history; prefix comparisons/interventions share real K2048 history and never commit alternatives
